title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: test_key_change_detection uses stale tx_history index for second receive
description:
File: python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py:574

In test_key_change_detection, the second receive does:

    await peer_ll.send(b"second")
    mock_radio.queue_rx(peer_radio.tx_history[0])  # BUG: should be [-1] or [1]
    result2 = await node_ll.receive(timeout_ms=100)

After two sends, tx_history contains [first_frame, second_frame]. Index [0] returns the first frame bytes, not the second. The test still passes because KEY_CHANGE (L562-570) is checked before replay protection (L593-599) in _receive_impl, but the test is not exercising the path its docstring claims.

Fix: change tx_history[0] to tx_history[-1].
